title.value: Discourse-Aware Unsupervised Summarization of Long Scientific Documents
title.justification: The title is located at the very beginning of the document and reflects the main subject of the paper: a new model for summarizing long scientific documents using discourse information.
title.quote: Discourse-Aware Unsupervised Summarization of Long Scientific Documents

analysis.description: The paper proposes an unsupervised graph-based ranking model called HIPO RANK for extractive summarization of long scientific documents. It uses a two-level hierarchical graph representation and asymmetrical positional cues to assess the importance of sentences. The method is tested on the PubMed and arXiv datasets, showing superior performance over other unsupervised models and competitiveness with supervised models.
